sn11.13:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ || || Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kuṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ || || Atha kho Mahāli licchavi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahāli licchavi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn11.13:2.1: Diṭṭho no bhante Bhagavatā Sakko devānam indo ti || ||
sn11.13:3.1: Diṭṭho kho me Mahāli Sakko devānam indo ti || ||
sn11.13:4.1: So hi nūna bhante sakkapaṭirūpako bhavissati || duddaso hi bhante Sakko devānam indo ti || ||
sn11.13:5.1: Sakkañcāham Mahāli jānāmi sakkakaraṇe ca dhamme yesaṃ dhammānaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā tañ ca pajānāmi || ||
sn11.13:6.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno Magho nāma māṇavako ahosi || tasmā Maghavā ti vuccati
sn11.13:10.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo sahassam pi atthānam muhuttena cinteti || tasmā Sahassakkho ti vuccati || ||
sn11.13:11.1: Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa Sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpatī || tasmā Sujampatīti vuccati || ||
sn11.13:12.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo devānam Tāvatiṃsānam issariyādhipaccam rajjaṃ kāresi || tasmā devānam indo vuccati || ||
sn11.13:13.1: Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā || || Katamāni satta vatapadāni || || Yāva jīvaṃ mātapettibharo assaṃ || || Yāva jīvaṃ kulejeṭṭhāpacāyī assaṃ || || Yāva jīvaṃ saṇhavāco assaṃ || || Yāvajīvaṃ apisuṇo assaṃ || || Yāva jīvaṃ vigatamalamacchereṇa cetasā agāram ajjhāvaseyyam muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || || Yāvajīvam saccavāco assaṃ || || Yāvajīvaṃ akodhano assaṃ || sa ce pi me kodho uppajjeyya khippam eva nam paṭivineyyan ti || || Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā ti || ||
sn11.13:14.1: Mātāpettibharaṃ jantuṃ || kulejeṭṭhāpacāyinaṃ || saṇhaṃ sakhilasambhāsaṃ || pesuṇeyyappahāyinam || ||
sn11.13:15.1: maccheravinaye yuttaṃ || saccaṃ kodhābhibhuṃ naraṃ || tam ve devā Tāvatiṃsā || āhu sappuriso itī ti || ||
